# The Bet · FinWise

> Module 1 · Ignite a PLG Motion. The growth hypothesis and where you're betting, plus the growth-loop visualization.

## Growth hypothesis

FinWise's biggest growth problem is Users are not seeing the in-depth value that the product can offer beyond a few use cases, because these use cases may be hard to discover and the users don't know what to do with the product beyond a point.

_Working notes: leaking growth Evidence: few paid conversions and churn Against the data: Trials -> paid conversion is consistently low and this is probably because users are not reaching / understanding the value of the product faster. This could also mean that they are engaging with the product on the surface vs going into depth_

_____

## The bet

Showing the most used features from existing users and the value from them can improve activation

**Not doing:** No net new acquisitions until existing product funnel gaps are fixed. No revenue optimization experiments as the focus is on conversion which automatically leads to better retention and revenue.

_____

## Growth loop

**Loop type:** Referral, Users probably need to know what they can do more with the product and identify such use cases. Typically, referrals from existing users signals that the product could potentially add value and could lead them to explore the product,
